content.value_statement: Teams need reliable agent identity and reputation context across chains. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through ERC-8004 resolution and AgentCard scaffolding.
actual_capabilities: Describes how to resolve an agent ID to owner and AgentCard using ChainGPT ERC-8004 tooling.
Lists the canonical Identity and Reputation registry addresses from the skill instructions.
Builds registration-v1 AgentCard drafts with services, supportedTrust, and x402Support fields.
Explains that registration, feedback, and validation writes are intentionally deferred.
Notes BASE_RPC_URL as an optional reliability setting for public RPC reads.
limitations: Does not include executable implementation files in this package.
Does not perform on-chain writes or submit registration transactions.
Depends on external ChainGPT ERC-8004 tools being available in the host.
Uses draft ERC-8004 behavior, which may change before finalization.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Registration
use_cases.description: Create a registration card before publishing an on-chain agent identity.

use_cases.title: Research Agent Identity
use_cases.description: Inspect ERC-8004 registry concepts and compare agent identity data across chains.

use_cases.title: Check Integration Metadata
use_cases.description: Resolve known agent IDs and review AgentCard service metadata before integration.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Genesis Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ERC-8004 skill to resolve agent ID 0 on Base. Summarize the owner, AgentCard location, and trust details.

prompt_templates.title: Find Registry Addresses
prompt_templates.prompt: List the canonical ERC-8004 Identity and Reputation registry addresses. Include supported chains and note any draft status.

prompt_templates.title: Draft AgentCard
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a registration-v1 AgentCard plan for an agent named <name>. Include services, supported trust models, and x402 support.

prompt_templates.title: Review Integration Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether my agent metadata is ready for ERC-8004 registration. Check endpoint completeness, trust model coverage, and x402 payment notes.

output_examples.output: The assistant returns a short owner and AgentCard summary, then flags any missing trust or endpoint details.

output_examples.input: Draft an AgentCard for a support agent with A2A and MCP services.
output_examples.output: The assistant describes the required card fields in plain language and provides a host-ready structure without submitting a transaction.
The assistant names the Identity and Reputation registries, supported chains, and draft caveats from the skill instructions.

best_practices: Verify registry addresses against the current ERC-8004 reference before production use.
Host AgentCards at stable HTTPS or IPFS locations before registration.
Treat write operations as out of scope until final ABIs are published.
anti_patterns: Do not submit identity or reputation transactions from this skill alone.
Do not assume draft ERC-8004 fields are final.
Do not publish AgentCards with missing service endpoints or trust model details.

faq.question: What is ERC-8004?
faq.answer: It is a draft standard for on-chain AI agent identity, discovery, and reputation.

faq.question: Does this skill register agents on-chain?
faq.answer: No. It supports read workflows and AgentCard scaffolding only.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require ChainGPT credits?
faq.answer: The skill text states that it uses zero ChainGPT credits.

faq.question: Can it resolve IPFS or data token URIs?
faq.answer: The instructions describe handling HTTPS, IPFS, and data token URI formats.

faq.question: Is BASE_RPC_URL required?
faq.answer: No. It is optional and improves reliability for Base RPC reads.
